entries.title: X1 CITY
entries.body: X1 CITY — The😂 Network phone UI (screenshot reviewed). Full diegetic cellular network as game-within-game: carrier (CARRIER-ISP), SIM x1c-00004472, number X1-440-2207, PING 18ms to x1.city. Coverage map gates content by zone (Downtown West, Solana Street, X1 Tower, Theo Nexus, Hangar/TNZ, Minerva Colony, Desert/Outskirts, BFC/Derby Arena, Ship Interiors, Alien Zone). Offline-first: cached prices, queued texts send when bars return, relay towers (DTW-RELAY-03). Theo's 😂 net report feeds this app's news layer — tracker doubles as content pipeline for X1 City.

entries.title: X1 WORLD (Bridges topic)
entries.body: X1 WORLD (Bridges topic): Jack confirmed he has a 7-dev core team — what they're building is undisclosed. Arnett tried to smoke out gossip, got nothing. Jack also asked about using the teleporter with the THORChain bridge (@ArnettX1); Marat shared THORChain v3.20 blog (XMR landing, ZEC next, SOL re-enabled).

entries.title: X1 WORLD (Fight Club topic)
entries.body: X1 WORLD (Fight Club topic): Skywalker vs Big Pande Pump + others — ongoing conduct-standard dispute. Skywalker repeatedly asks for a baseline of respect/conduct; Big Pande Pump + others respond with personal attacks (schizo/medical-record mockery, wife jokes, DARVO accusations, 'P-A-N-T-S attack' joke). Skywalker pasted a long DARVO/group-dynamics analysis and called on @jacklevinj to address the community. Theo gave neutral DARVO/psychology analysis, refused to take sides, then stepped out of the thread. **Jack has NOT publicly responded.**

entries.title: The😂 Network
entries.body: **The😂 Network** — X1 City got a phone 📱. First phone + internet provider inside the UE5 city. Apps live: X1B, Wallet, Map, Messages, Store, Camera. Meme coin launches on X1 → plugs into game. 😂/XNT $0.0₅348 (+11.08%). [Tweet](https://x.com/X1Brains/status/2092630274425167946) · [Tweet](https://x.com/X1Brains/status/2092426858809713102)
